summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf with net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0 and net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_source_route=0, applied at runtime with `sysctl -p`, and confirmed the OpenRC `sysctl` service (boot runlevel) loads /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf on startup. Verified persistence by rebooting node1 via the native `reboot` command, confirming a changed kernel boot_id (d0fcb49d... → 8b9e7b1c...) and reconfirming all four sysctl values remained 0 and networking (eth0) was healthy post-restart.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values and boot_id on node1 (cmd-4d9ba90574284670, cmd-a09e3a0edf6d49fc)
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects and accept_source_route for all/default (cmd-57d8a7bf8edd4fe3)
Applied config at runtime with sysctl -p and verified live values are 0 (cmd-ae50ea9400854eea)
Confirmed OpenRC sysctl service is enabled at boot runlevel and loads /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf, with /etc/sysctl.d taking precedence over /lib and /usr/lib (cmd-43d5ed71896045ee, cmd-d776c8e80ed140e1)
Issued native reboot on node1, polled until exec connectivity returned
Verified changed boot_id post-restart proving an actual reboot occurred (cmd-bc426a4661834f52)
Re-verified all four sysctl values remained 0 and eth0 networking healthy after restart (cmd-aad7b01dbca348fe)

evidence.summary: sysctl.d config sets net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_redirects=0; applied live and confirmed still 0 after reboot
sysctl.d config sets net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_source_route=0; applied live and confirmed still 0 after reboot

evidence.requirement: Config loads automatically at boot (persistence mechanism)
evidence.summary: OpenRC sysctl service enabled at boot runlevel; init script iterates /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf and applies them on startup, with /etc/sysctl.d taking precedence over vendor defaults

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (d0fcb49d-3eec-44ac-aa8b-e079221dc958) and healthy networking/service state
